item.title: Vance to host Congress at White House to discuss legislative action on fraud
item.description: Vice President JD Vance will host about 20 members of Congress at the White House to discuss legislative action targeting Medicare and Medicaid fraud.

item.title: Giuliani to Newsmax: Mamdani Should Consider Skipping 9/11 Ceremony
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani might consider not attending this year's Sept. 11 commemoration if his presence would worsen the pain of victims' families.

item.title: Zohran Mamdani Hit With More Bad News After Walking Back Grocery Store Announcement
Wisconsin Socialist Hong Defends Call to Cancel Thanksgiving
item.description: Wisconsin state Rep. Francesca Hong, the leading Democratic candidate for governor, faces renewed scrutiny over her past calls to abolish Thanksgiving.
